about: Synthetic Outer Sunset storm-flood exercise. Fictional; every report is authored. What the live run receives, in transmit order.

input.text: School gym evacuation complete. Everyone our team checked is outside.
North shelter open at the church hall. 18 people here, blankets needed tonight.
House on 47th near Judah: water rising downstairs, two people waiting upstairs.
44th and Judah: power line down on the sidewalk, sparking. Keeping people back.
North shelter: 24 people now, two with small kids.
Apartment block on Judah: power out, elevator stuck between floors, nobody inside it.
House on 43rd near Lawton: elderly man alone, no heat, needs blankets.
44th and Judah: kids trying to get close to the wire. We are holding them back.
School sports hall checked. Our search of that area is complete.
47th and Judah: water at the second step of the stairs now.
Strong smell of gas at 41st and Moraga. We told neighbors to stay out.
Corner store: front window smashed by the wind, glass all over the sidewalk.
Repeating: north shelter still needs blankets tonight.
Parents gathering at the school gate asking about their kids. About 20 adults here.
Grocery store at 45th and Judah is open, giving out bottled water.
41st and Moraga: we can hear hissing by the meter. Smell is stronger.
Apartment block: stairwell lights out, residents using phone lights.
46th and Lawton: basement flooding, family pumping water, they need sandbags.
46th and Lawton: their pump is too small, water still coming in.
47th and Judah: the people upstairs have asked for help, water still rising.
43rd and Lawton: the elderly man says he is out of his heart pills.
44th and Judah: taped off the corner around the wire.
House on 48th near Kirkham: dog trapped in the flooded garage. Owner is safe.
North shelter: a woman here needs her insulin, it is still at home on 45th.
41st and Moraga: gas meter is on the side of the yellow house.
Hardware store at 43rd and Lawton has sandbags. We need a truck to move them.
School office says 212 students were on site today. Teachers have the roster outside.
46th and Lawton: family asks if they should turn off the power, water near the outlets.
Apartment block: two residents on the 4th floor use oxygen machines, batteries running low.
47th and Judah: we need a boat or high truck, street water too deep to walk.
Beach cafe staff are staying. We can serve hot food to about 30 people.
41st and Moraga: moved 8 neighbors to the end of the block.
Grocery store at 45th and Judah: long line for water, about 60 people.
Correction: the school gym is clear, but someone may still be upstairs in the main building.
Repeating corner store: broken glass on the sidewalk.
Repeating 44th and Judah: live wire on the sidewalk, still sparking.
48th and Kirkham: garage water about waist deep, we can hear the dog barking.
School main building: stairwell door jammed, we cannot get to the second floor yet.
Someone is shouting for help near the dunes. We cannot see where.
46th and Lawton: we helped them turn off the main breaker.
Apartment block 6th floor: elderly woman cannot walk down the stairs, wants to stay.
44th and Judah: sparks getting bigger, small fire in the hedge.
South shelter open at the church hall on Moraga. 25 people, we need cots.
Hardware store: people lining up for sandbags, about 25.
Repeating the school report: possible person upstairs in the main building.
Repeating: insulin needed at the north shelter.
Repeating: 47th and Judah, two people upstairs, need a high truck.
42nd and Judah: neighbor not answering her door, lights off since this morning.
44th and Judah: hedge fire went out in the rain. Wire still live.
Repeating: gas smell at 41st and Moraga.
45th and Kirkham: tree fell on the roof. Family is safe, roof leaking.
Beach patrol walking the dunes south of the parking lot, still hearing shouts.
South shelter: a child here has a high fever. Parents want a medic.
Truck delivered 40 bottles of water to the north shelter.
Medic team brought heart pills to 43rd and Lawton. He has taken them.
40th and Moraga: car stuck in the flooded intersection, water at the doors, driver still inside.
Repeating: dog trapped in garage at 48th and Kirkham.
School roster check: 210 of 212 students counted outside. Two not found yet.
40th and Moraga: intersection water about two feet deep, rising.
Medic team at the apartment block. Oxygen users stable for now, need batteries within two hours.
Grocery store: an older man slipped in the line and hit his head. He is awake.
Beach cafe running on gas stove, no power. Still cooking.
School report refers to the main building beside the gym.
Truck dropped 30 blankets at the north shelter.
Repeating: 42nd and Judah neighbor not answering her door.
Sandbags delivered to 46th and Lawton. Basement water holding.
Corner store owner is here, sweeping glass. Says nobody was hurt.
Hardware store: 60 sandbags left, truck can take more.
Grocery store running on a generator, freezers on.
Repeating: school is missing two students on the roster.
Beach motel: ground floor flooded, guests moved upstairs, all accounted for.
Repeating: 45th and Kirkham, tree on the roof, leaking.
Medic at the south shelter checked the child with fever. Stable, gave medicine, will check again in an hour.
40th and Moraga: threw a rope to the driver, he is holding on, trying to get out.
Repeating: shouting for help near the dunes, south of the beach parking lot.
Medic team at the grocery store, checked the man who fell. Small cut, no other injury.
South shelter: 12 more people arrived, now 37. Still need cots and water.
Apartment block: water coming into the parking garage, about knee deep.
Has everyone at the school been rescued?
42nd and Judah: looked in the window, no one in the front room. Car is gone.
Utility crew on the way to 44th and Judah, 10 minutes.
41st and Moraga: gas company crew is here, the gas is shut off. Neighbors can go back.
Medic team brought insulin to the north shelter. She has taken it, doing fine.
Earlier school gym report: all people our team checked were outside.
Repeating: south shelter needs cots.
Supply truck 1 loaded 80 sandbags at the hardware store.
46th and Moraga: checked the whole block, everyone is fine.
Repeating: 43rd and Lawton, elderly man needs blankets and heat.
School: one of the two missing students was picked up early by a parent. One still not found.
40th and Moraga: driver is out of the car and safe. Car still in the water.
Dunes: shouting stopped. We keep searching.
Correction for 42nd and Judah: the neighbor answered. She is fine, her phone was dead.
Corner store giving out batteries and flashlights.
Medic team at 47th and Judah. Both residents out, in our truck, mild cold.
Truck brought 60 bottles of water to the south shelter.
Beach cafe: hot soup ready, can send to the shelters.
45th and Kirkham: the tree also pulled the phone line down, it is lying in the yard.
Correction from the beach motel: one guest from room 12 is missing. Was not upstairs.
48th and Kirkham: dog is out of the garage, owner has it.
Apartment garage: someone may be sleeping in a car down there, residents saw him earlier.
47th and Judah house is empty now, door locked.
Grocery store: water running low, about 50 bottles left.
Beach motel: searching the ground floor rooms for the missing guest from room 12.
Repeating 46th and Lawton: basement water holding with sandbags.
40th and Moraga: put cones out, cars turning around.
School main building search is not complete. We cannot give an all-clear.
North shelter: 41 people, the hall is getting full. We can take about 10 more.
Repeating: motel room 12 guest missing, beach patrol told.
43rd and Lawton: elderly man moved to the south shelter with blankets.
Apartment garage checked. The car was empty, man had already left on foot.
44th and Judah: utility crew has cut power to the line. Area is safe.
Corner store sidewalk swept, glass gone.
Beach cafe: 5 volunteers here, can drive food to the shelters.
South shelter received 20 cots. Still need water for 37 people.
Beach motel: the car of the room 12 guest is still in the lot.
Found the person near the dunes: a surfer with a hurt ankle, walking him to the parking lot.
The neighbor from 42nd and Judah is at the south shelter, charging her phone.
Apartment block: batteries arrived for the oxygen machines.
46th and Lawton: two neighbor basements on the block flooding too.
45th and Kirkham: tarp on the roof, leak stopped.
40th and Moraga driver checked by medic, cold but no injury.
South shelter: the elderly man from 43rd and Lawton arrived, warm now.
Repeating: motel guest from room 12 still missing.
46th and Moraga: water starting to come up the driveways now.
Medic team met the beach patrol at the parking lot. Surfer ankle likely broken, taking him to the clinic.
Repeating grocery store: about 50 bottles of water left.
Corner store out of batteries.
41st and Moraga all clear, gas off, residents back home.
Utility team set up a generator at the apartment block lobby for charging.
Beach cafe sent soup to the south shelter with a volunteer driver.
Hardware store: out of sandbags now.
44th and Judah: tape taken down, sidewalk open.
40th and Moraga: second car drove into the water and stalled. Two people inside, water at the windows.
North shelter heater stopped working. It is cold in the hall.
Man at the beach cafe says he is staying at the motel, room 12. He went out for food before the flood.
School main building: fire crew opened the jammed stairwell door. Going upstairs now.
40th and Moraga: both people from the second car climbed out onto the roof. We are getting them a ladder.
Supply truck 1 dropped 200 bottles of water at the grocery store.
South shelter count: 52 people. Cots for 20, rest on mats.
48th and Kirkham: dog has a cut paw, owner wants a vet.
Hardware store: 200 more sandbags coming from the city yard in 30 minutes.
Beach motel manager confirmed: the man at the cafe is our room 12 guest. Everyone accounted for.
School main building second floor: found one student hiding in a classroom, scared but not hurt.
Sandbags dropped at 46th and Moraga.
Apartment block 6th floor: checked the elderly woman, she has food and water, fine to stay.
41st and Moraga: gas crew checked all houses on the block, no leaks found.
School roster: the student found upstairs is the one we were missing. All 212 now accounted for.
Both residents from 47th and Judah dropped at the north shelter, warm.
Utility team fixed the north shelter heater, hall warming up.
40th and Moraga: both people from the second car are on dry ground with the medic team. Cold but fine.
Corner store: water coming in the back door now.
Beach cafe: a volunteer burned her hand on the stove, needs first aid.
South shelter: three families arrived with dogs, we need a spot for the animals.
More sandbags dropped on 46th and Lawton for the neighbors.
School main building fully searched, all floors. Nobody else inside.
42nd and Judah neighbor is back home, thanked the team.
Grocery store closing at dark. Water handout moving to the north shelter.
Medic treated the burn at the beach cafe. Minor, she is back to work.
Apartment block: one oxygen machine stopped again, generator cable too short to reach the 4th floor.
Beach patrol: tide coming up into the dunes, keeping people off the beach.
Beach motel: ground floor water going down slowly.
School: two students still missing from the roster, please send help.
46th and Moraga: one house has water inside, older couple on the ground floor wants to leave.
North shelter: running out of food, 45 people for dinner.
Apartment block: ran a longer cable to the 4th floor. Both oxygen machines running.
South shelter: child fever is down, doing well.
44th and Judah: second pole leaning badly next to the first one. No wire down yet.
Hardware store: city sandbags arrived, 200 ready.
School gate: all parents have picked up their kids or are with the teachers.
43rd and Lawton: elderly man alone with no heat, please check on him.
Supply truck brought a pump to the corner store. Water going down.
Grocery store closed for the night.
45th and Kirkham: new crack in the ceiling under the tree. Family moved to the back room.
Beach cafe: out of soup, will make more in an hour.
42nd and Judah: neighbor still not answering, we are worried.
Supply truck 1 delivered 30 more cots to the south shelter.
46th and Moraga: helped the older couple out, they are going to the south shelter.
Beach cafe soup delivered to the north shelter, enough for everyone tonight.
46th and Lawton: all three basements holding, pumps running.
Motel guest from room 12 still missing, beach patrol searching the sand.
Repeating: apartment oxygen machines running on generator.
Medic team wrapped the dog paw at 48th and Kirkham, it is fine.
Repeating: 200 sandbags at the hardware store.
Repeating: south shelter has 52 people.
45th and Kirkham: family left for the south shelter until an inspector comes.
47th and Judah: water still rising, people upstairs, hurry.
Repeating: north shelter almost full, about 45 people.
40th and Moraga: tow truck asked for both cars, water going down.
School: teachers and staff leaving, building locked.
Apartment block: residents settling in for the night, generator on.
